candidates.snippet: His autobiography appeared, after two revisions, as The Life and Times of Frederick Douglass (London, 1882). See F. M. Holland, Frederick Douglass , The Colored Orator (New York, 1891); C. W. Chesnutt , Frederick Douglass , (Boston, 1899); and Booker T. Washington , Frederick Douglass (Philadelphia, 1907), in the series of American Crisis Biographies.
